product_family: No-code app builder (iOS, Android, web) with AI-powered generation (Ada). Includes hosted Postgres database, visual canvas, component marketplace, integrations with Zapier, Xano, and payment processors. Enterprise offering: Adalo Blue (private infrastructure, on-prem options).

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1 or 2)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of SOC 2 certification found. Adalo's public security guide describes its security controls (encryption, bcrypt hashing, breach notification) but does not claim SOC 2 certification, and no SOC 2 report or trust page is published on the vendor domain.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification found in Adalo's official documentation, security guide, privacy policy, or trust resources.

certifications.name: GDPR (Compliance Posture)
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy policy states 'Adalo processes Customer Content solely on behalf of and according to the instructions of the customer, as described in our Terms of Use and applicable data processing agreements.' Features include data export, deletion, and consent mechanisms for GDPR compliance.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA compliance or certification found. Forum discussions about HIPAA exist but do not indicate formal compliance certification or BAA availability.

certifications.name: PCI DSS (via Stripe)
certifications.proof_quote: Adalo itself does not hold PCI DSS certification. The PCI Level 1 certification belongs to Stripe, its payment processor, not to Adalo. Adalo's security guide states card data 'never touches Adalo's servers' and is handled by Stripe (a PCI Level 1 Service Provider). This is a processor certification, not a certification held by Adalo.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 / 27018 / 27701 (Cloud / Data Privacy Extensions)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27017, 27018, or 27701 certifications found in Adalo's official documentation.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP authorization found.

privacy.ai_training_note: Ada AI assistant is included in all Adalo plans. Public documentation does not disclose whether Ada trains on customer app data or conversations. Privacy policy references 'Terms of Use and applicable data processing agreements' but Ada's specific training practices are not publicly disclosed.
privacy.data_region: United States (default). Adalo Blue enterprise offering mentions 'Region-specific dedicated infrastructure' but specific region options not detailed publicly.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: HTTPS with TLS encryption on all connections (specific TLS version not stated by vendor)

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: AES encryption for data at rest (vendor states 'AES standards' / industry-leading encryption at-rest; AES-256 is cited by the vendor specifically for Stripe-handled card data)

security.name: Uptime SLA
security.value: 99%+ average app uptime. Adalo Blue Private Spaces: 99% SLA

security.name: SSL Certificate Provisioning
security.value: Automatic SSL certificate provisioning for custom domains

security.name: Breach Notification
security.value: Adalo commits to notifying customers of data breaches within 24-48 hours

security.name: App Store Security Reviews
security.value: Apps published to Apple App Store and Google Play Store undergo platform security reviews before availability

products.name: Adalo (Standard)
products.data_scope: Customer apps: built on hosted Postgres database or external datasources (Airtable, Google Sheets, Xano). Adalo platform data: user accounts, project metadata. Customer app data: customer responsibility to configure security.
products.notes: Free plan includes 500 records, web publishing. Paid plans include native app store publishing. Ada AI included in all plans.

products.name: Adalo Blue (Enterprise)
products.data_scope: Same as standard, but with dedicated infrastructure options. Mentions 'Region-specific dedicated infrastructure' and 'customer-managed environment' for on-prem deployments.
products.notes: Offers Private Spaces (99% SLA, DevOps support) and Site License (on-prem hosting). Described as meeting 'strict regulatory and compliance standards' but specific certifications not detailed.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (free plan with limits) + tiered subscription ($36/month to enterprise). No per-transaction fees. Single app version publishes to web, iOS, and Android.
compare.data_residency: US default. Adalo Blue allows region-specific and on-prem options.

flags: SOC 2 absent - third-party reviews explicitly note this as a limitation vs competitors (Bubble, Glide have SOC 2 Type II). Adalo's public security guide does not claim SOC 2.
ISO 27001 absent - no public evidence found.
Ada AI training practices not disclosed - privacy policy does not specify whether Ada (the AI assistant) trains on user interactions, app descriptions, or customer data.
Trust center URL broken - security.adalo.com redirects to unrelated app (INCODE BLACK COMPANY quiz), not a valid security/trust page.

Adalo Blue enterprise offering vague on compliance - mentions 'strict regulatory and compliance standards' and 'meet your compliance needs' but does not detail specific certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, etc.).
HIPAA discussions on forum but no formal certification - users discuss HIPAA use cases in forums; no BAA or formal HIPAA compliance claim found.
